description: This file defines transport classes for server communication over WebSocket and TCP socket, including interfaces and implementations for message handling, connection management, and event emission.

classes.name: WebSocketServerTransport
classes.description: Handles WebSocket communication implementing the ServerTransport interface.

classes.name: SocketServerTransport
classes.description: Handles TCP socket communication with event emission, implementing the ServerTransport interface.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over the transport.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the transport connection with an optional reason.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Checks if the transport connection is closed.

methods.name: _dispatch
methods.description: Internal method to process incoming buffer data and emit complete messages.
